newsitem.title: USA: GenRad shares slip on Q1 warning - analysts.
newsitem.headline: GenRad shares slip on Q1 warning - analysts.

text.p: Shares of GenRad Inc dropped about 34 percent on Monday after the company warned Wall Street analysts its first quarter earnings may fall below estimates, analysts said.
"The stock is off because the company is indicating weaker than expected first quarter results," said Mark Kelleher, an analyst at Fechtorm Detwiter.
GenRad, which manufactures hardware and software to help firms maximize productivity, dropped 6-1/4 to 12.
GenRad did not return calls seeking comment.
GenRad told analysts that its first quarter marketing expenses would be higher than expected, while revenues would be slightly lower, analysts said.
Kelleher said he trimmed his first quarter estimate to $0.21 a share, compared with Wall Street's consensus estimate of $0.27 a share.
GenRad remains comfortable with consensus earnings estimates of $1.25 a share for the full year 1997, analysts said.
